story_type: children stranded on rocks by the tide, helicopter basket hoist
hook: Three kids were stuck on the rocks as the tide came in.
narration: Three kids were stuck on a pile of rocks, and the tide was coming in.
High tide had cut them off near Fleming Point, by Golden Gate Fields in California.
A Coast Guard helicopter came in low over the bay.
It can't land on wet rocks, so the crew holds a hover and sends a rescue basket down on a cable.
[short pause] Then the kids were lifted up off the rocks, into the dusk.
outcome: The crew hoisted all three children aboard and flew them away from the rocks.
title: Three kids stranded on rocks by the tide
description:
In July 2010, a Coast Guard helicopter crew hoisted three children who were stranded on rocks by high tide near Fleming Point and Golden Gate Fields, California, and flew them away.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Ricky Allen, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/89764
